name.en-US: Defence of the Declaration of the Gallican Clergy
name.pt-BR: Defesa da Declaração do clero galicano

description.la: Defensio declarationis cleri gallicani de ecclesiastica potestate, in undecim libros divisa : de potestate temporali regum, de auctoritate conciliorum et de pontificis judicio. Composita circa 1682-1685, edita 1730. Editio Lachat (1865).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s Latin defence, in eleven books, of the four articles of the Declaration of the French clergy of 1682 on ecclesiastical power: the temporal power of kings, the authority of councils and the judgment of the pope. Composed around 1682-85 and published in 1730. A document of Gallicanism, kept for its historical interest: the articles were withdrawn by their own signatories in 1693. Lachat edition (1865).
description.pt-BR: Defesa latina, em onze livros, dos quatro artigos da Declaração do clero de França de 1682 sobre o poder eclesiástico: o poder temporal dos reis, a autoridade dos concílios e o juízo do papa. Composta por volta de 1682-1685 e publicada em 1730. Documento do galicanismo, conservado por seu interesse histórico: os artigos foram retirados por seus próprios signatários em 1693. Edição Lachat (1865).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Bibliothèque monastique (Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais), Wayback Machine
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXI (Avis, Declaratio, Defensio, books I-VI) and volume XXII (Pars tertia, books VII-XI).
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
